candidates.change_summary: Change || to && so the interface is only reported when both AccessControl's own and super's checks pass.
Remove the disjunction with super.supportsInterface so only IAccessControl's interface id is supported.
Replace the own-interface check with super's check only, so IAccessControl's interface id is no longer reported.
Compare against IERC165's interface id instead of IAccessControl's, changing which selectors return true.
